_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbXQ1XffyfWbgHS4nxAXKADA)_

Fixes #31499

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:按 QA 运行 #31486 的实测，改正平台测试清单里 25 个条目的文字(22 处条目纠正、4 处覆盖缺口写进各条目已有的 `knownGaps`、1 处夹具清理说明)，每个条目升一个 revision 并加一行引用该运行的 history。
- **为什么改**:这些条目写的步骤或判据已与当前平台不符(工具数、路由、表名、请求体形状、界面入口等),照旧执行会让下一轮 QA 白跑或误判;缺口记在条目上，下一轮不必重新发现。
- **风险与回滚**:风险很低，只改 `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json` 的文字，不动代码、测试或钩子，也不新增或拆分条目;回滚即还原这些 JSON。
- **先看**:`identity-auth.json` 的 `email-verification-loop`(改动最大：邮件改读 `sys_identity_email`,并改用 SMTP 收件桩);`records-forms.json` 的 `form-view-gallery`(覆盖层改走定制配对);`platform-core.json` 的 `package-lifecycle-enable-disable`。
- **两分钟验证**:`node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`,预期打印 `check-platform-checklist: OK — 16 areas, 360 items` 并以 0 退出。
- **需要你做的**:无，席位落地。

## What changes

The QA run #31486 (owed:weekly, subject `0647dabb`) met 22 checklist-accuracy findings, 4 coverage gaps and one fixture-hygiene note; the card lists each. This PR applies them to the named items of `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json`. Every touched item bumps `revision` by one and gains one `history` row (date 2026-11-08, ref `#31499`) that cites the run and the base it was read at. No item is added, split or retired, and no file outside `areas/*.json` changes.

`platform-core.json` was edited last and `origin/main` merged in before this PR opened, as the claim orders (the #31497/#31498 pair edits two other items in that file).

## Tests

No test, code or hook changes. The checklist validator is the gate on this diff: `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` exits 0. A semantic diff against `origin/main` (both sides parsed as JSON) shows exactly the 25 named items changed, each with `revision` +1 and `history` +1, no area-level key changed, and item sets and order unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- Step-1 spot-check on `origin/main` 4894cfe1: the premises of lines 1, 4, 8, 13, 18 and 20 all hold, so no line is dropped. Line 1: `wireBridgeTools` in `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` registers 15 data and action tools, and the federation pair is scope-gated. Line 4: `migrate/apply.ts` and `migrate/comment-reactions.ts` declare no `dev` flag. Line 8: `AppContent.tsx` sends `/apps/APP/metadata` and `metadata/_diagnostics` to `SetupMetadataRoute`, which redirects to `studioMetadataAreaPath`. Line 13: `IDENTITY_EMAIL_OBJECT` is `sys_identity_email`. Line 18: no `packages/:id/published` route exists. Line 20: `batch-routes.ts` parses `deleteMany` through `DeleteManyDataRequestSchema`.
- Line 4 is worded "apply and comment-reactions take no `--dev`", not "only organization-ownership and serve do": `migrate/packageless-overlays.ts` and `migrate/security-catalog-overlays.ts` declare `--dev` too. The seat accepted this wording.
- Placement readings: line 8's `OBJECT.default` note sits on steps[8], the planted-row leg it describes, since steps[3] and [6] plant nothing. Line 16's `data.runs` note sits on steps[0], the item's first runs read, because steps[8] (New similar) reads no runs list. Line 19's "variant 2" is read 1-based, as variants[1] (Studio Publish on a read-only package). Line 11 names no index, so steps[1], [2] and [4] carry it. Line 1 also widens acceptance[4].verify's degradation list to the file pair.
- Fixture hygiene was measured by feeding the Bash guard's own hook script `rm -rf examples/qa-picklist-showcase` with each cwd: the shared primary checkout answers exit 2 (blocked), a linked worktree exit 0.
- The run's close-out also parked `identity-auth.auth-method-matrix` acceptance[0] and `integration-system.email-template-render` acceptance[5] on #31499. The card's coverage-gaps list does not name them, so they are untouched.

## Verification

All readings are on objectstack `claude/project-thread-eiodyp`. The edits were read at base `4894cfe1`, and the gates ran at the merged head `c1789f47` (main `9431c45d` plus the two commits).

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at merged head `c1789f47` derived 16 families for the 13 changed paths (288 changed lines, under the 3000 human-merge threshold). All 16 exit 0: `check-adr-links` (+ `--self-test`), `check-closing-keyword-parity` (+ `--self-test`, on this body), `check-comment-mask-corpus`, `ci/plan-test-core-shards --self-test`, `@objectstack/lint check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:ci-filter-parity`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:driver-memory-census`, `check:gitlink-declared`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:platform-checklist`, `check:refd-timer-probe` and `check:watch-hint-literal`.

`check:doc-formula-expressions` first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, nothing measured) in the fresh worktree. After its named prerequisite, `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint` under the verify lock (VERDICT command-exit 0), it exited 0. `dispatch-gates --ran` reconciliation: 16 derived, 16 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.

Not local, per the derivation: CI's `Plan Test Core shards` step and the conditional `Type Check UI` lane, which no path in this diff feeds.

</details>
